features: Single channel HD-SDI mini DVR with HD-SDI loop-through
Recording: 1920 x 1080p or 1280 x 720p, 1 ~ 25 FPS, H.264 AVI
notes: Recording modes are given as schedule / motion detection / manual on the spec sheet and as continuous / motion / alarm / manual on the product page.
Spec sheet labels the alarm output as a motion output.
Spec sheet describes the included card as 64 GB SDHC; the product page lists a 64GB SDXC card.
Power consumption stated as 3 W max, +/- 10%.
Maximum camera resolution is not stated in megapixels; recording resolution is 1920 x 1080p or 1280 x 720p.
